summary:
Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repo; nothing committed and no tests run, per instructions.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: new TimeElapsedColumn (after BarColumn, before TimeRemainingColumn); Task.finished_time field (after _get_time, before visible); Task.finished is now finished_time is not None; _reset clears finished_time; update and advance capture elapsed as the last step under the lock when completed >= total and no finished time is set; reset clears finished_time explicitly.
- rich/default_styles.py: progress.elapsed set to yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ returns a Table (Index, RGB, Color columns; title "Palette"; right-justified caption "N colors"; highlight on). Color, Style, Table and Text are imported inside the method, and Table only under TYPE_CHECKING.
- CHANGELOG.md: [Unreleased] / Added entry naming Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_palette.py (new): test_rich_cast.
- tests/test_progress.py: new test_time_elapsed_column (unstarted, running, frozen, driven by start_task/advance with a manual clock); TimeElapsedColumn imported and added to test_columns; test_columns expected line regenerated by hand trace.

Interpretation: the spec's test_columns is tests/test_progress.py::test_columns; tests/test_columns.py is unrelated and untouched.

Not verified: test_columns was not run. Its expected output was derived by tracing clock reads by hand (10 reads per unfinished started row, 9 otherwise). Elapsed values: 0:00:37 and 0:00:36 in unfinished frames; 0:01:00 and 0:00:45 in finished frames. Speeds become "1 byte/s" for both tasks, narrowing the speed column. Bar widths go 33→25 in unfinished frames and 23→16 in finished frames. Grep counts confirmed the bar widths and elapsed cells match the trace. The new palette and column tests were also not run.
